queries.query: Lhasa China official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS service
queries.result: Search found a public ArcGIS REST FeatureServer named Historic_Lhasa_GIS_WFL1 with a Parcel layer, and official Lhasa/Xizang natural-resources pages describing local unified real-estate registration and public geographic-information services.

queries.query: 拉萨 官方 不动产登记 地籍图 地图 服务
queries.result: Search found the official Lhasa Natural Resources Bureau result page and a local official article on 不动产登记; it did not expose an anonymous current cadastral parcel API. The official Xizang page identifies 天地图·西藏 as a public geographic-information service portal.

registryEvidence.custodian: Lhasa Municipal Natural Resources Bureau / Lhasa Real Estate Registration Center
registryEvidence.evidence: The official Lhasa bureau reports unified real-estate registration work and provides a local official registration-information procedure page; this establishes a local registry/procedure, not an open parcel download.

sourceAssessment.serviceDescription: Circa mid-20th c. urban composition of Lhasa based on the Peter Aufschnaiter map of 1949 and a declassified USGS aerial image from 1966.
sourceAssessment.crs: EPSG:3857 service coordinates; anonymous GeoJSON request returned EPSG:4326
sourceAssessment.nativeIdentity: OBJECTID (ArcGIS OID); source also exposes DISTRICT, ID, and PD_ID, but those fields were not retained as parcel properties.

boundedPointRequest.request: Envelope 91.1195–91.1215 longitude, 29.6585–29.6595 latitude; spatialRelIntersects; where=1=1; outFields=OBJECTID; returnGeometry=false
boundedPointRequest.interpretation: The WUP point is outside this layer extent. This is a map extent miss, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

uncertainty: The public parcel layer is historical and not evidenced as the current local cadastral registry.
The official local registry pages establish procedure/custodian context but no anonymous current parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.
No parcel sample is retained because the available polygons are outside the exact WUP-point window and the source scope is historical; no coordinate was shifted to force a hit.
